subject: Re: Rate limits & overage pricing — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call recap — rate limits & overage pricing (next steps)

Hi John / team,

Thanks for the quick chat earlier — great to hear more about the workflow and traffic patterns. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

1) Estimated volumes (from your call):
   - Baseline production: ~300M tokens/day (avg).
   - Peak burst windows: up to ~5–7M tokens/minute for short windows (1–5 mins) during heavy customer events.
   - Monthly target: ~8–9B tokens/month once fully rolled out.

2) Budget range and unit economics you shared:
   - Target budget: $10k–$15k/month initially for pilot; scale budget TBD based on unit economics.
   - Target unit: you mentioned wanting a target around $700–$900 per 1M tokens for the immediate MVP, then optimizing with batching/quant and Dedicated options.

3) Rate limits & overage concerns we covered:
   - Hosted default quotas will throttle sustained throughput; we can provide burst capacity for short windows but sustained high throughput will need Dedicated or reserved capacity.
   - Overage pricing applies if you exceed agreed quota on Hosted. We discussed options: quota bump (temporary), committed capacity, or a blended overage rate depending on the volume band.

4) Action items / next steps:
   - Marissa (me): share a short note that outlines the overage tiers, sample unit-econ calc, and an attachment with our current overage terms (attached).
   - Rafael: will draft committed capacity options and indicative pricing for Dedicated (monthly commit scenarios).
   - John / Procurement: confirm peak burst sizing (tokens/minute) and whether Acme needs guaranteed burst or if best-effort is acceptable. Also confirm your procurement cadence / timelines.

Please see the attached Redwood_Overage_Terms_v2.pdf and the sample token estimates workbook (ACME_monthly_token_estimates.xlsx) — both are a starting point. If the target $/1M tokens around $700–$900 is non-negotiable for the pilot, let me know and we’ll prioritize model/runtime levers + reserved capacity options to hit that profile.

Suggested short follow-up: 30m on Monday to lock down peak burst numbers and choose committed vs hosted path. I can include Rafael to walk through Dedicated sizing.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Peak burst: the 5–7M tokens/minute estimate is what we saw in staging during campaign spikes; production could be slightly higher (~8M) but those would be very short (under 3 minutes) and infrequent (~2–3x per day).
- Budget: for the pilot program we can stretch to $15k/month if unit economics look defensible; for broader rollout we’d be looking at committed spend decisions in Q4 so Rafael’s committed capacity options will be important.
- Overage / quota bumps: procurement will want clear guardrails. What does a temporary quota increase look like (time-limited, cap on # of increases)? Also need clarity on notification windows before overage billing.

Let’s do Monday 30m — John, Procurement team available Mon 09:30 PT. If you can send the overage tiers and a short sample calc today, we can review ahead of the call.

—John

John — thanks, noted. Below are the concrete overage/quota notes and a quick sample unit-econ for the pilot to show how you’d land near the $700–$900 /1M target.

Overage & quota increase summary (hosted):
- Temporary quota bump: one-off increases available up to 2x current quota for windows up to 24 hours with 2 business-hours notice; additional increases require review.
- Burst handling: we support short-duration bursts (up to ~10M tokens/min) as best-effort; sustained capacity > baseline requires committed Dedicated pools.
- Notification & billing: we send usage alerts at 80% and 95% of quota; overage is charged on actual usage for the invoice period and visible in the Console within 24hrs. No retroactive one-off rebates unless agreed in contract.
- Overage tiers (example):
   * Tier A: up to +10% of quota — $1,200 per 1M tokens
   * Tier B: +10% to +50% of quota — $950 per 1M tokens
   * Tier C: >+50% of quota — $700 per 1M tokens (volume-discounted; requires post-usage reconciliation)

Sample unit-econ (pilot example):
- Pilot baseline: 300M tokens/day => ~9B tokens/month
- If we price Hosted with a contracted quota that covers baseline and allow limited Tier B bursts, blended effective rate could be ~ $850 /1M tokens.
- If you move to a Dedicated monthly commit (Rafael will provide scenarios) we can get to $650–$750 /1M tokens depending on quantization and batching targets.

Attachments: I’ve attached the ACME_monthly_token_estimates.xlsx with two scenarios (Hosted-blended, Dedicated-commit). Rafael — can you draft 2 committed capacity options (monthly commit levels + indicative pricing) and I’ll include those in the Monday deck for procurement.

I’ll schedule Mon 09:30 PT and share a calendar invite. If procurement needs different timing, flag it.

Cheers,
Marissa
